children: Quoin Pharmaceuticals announced FDA Fast Track Designation for QRX003 in Peeling Skin Syndrome, enabling closer FDA engagement as it readies a Phase 2/3 study in 2H 2026.
FDA granted Fast Track Designation to QRX003 for Peeling Skin Syndrome, the first-ever Fast Track for this disease.
This is QRX003’s second Fast Track, following designation for Netherton Syndrome.
Designation follows FDA clearance of Quoin’s IND in July 2026 for Peeling Skin Syndrome.
Quoin expects to initiate a Phase 2/3 study in 2H 2026, enrolling up to 12 pediatric and adult patients in the U.S. and Europe.
QRX003 development supported by investigator-led pediatric data showing sustained improvements and no reported adverse events over 15+ months.
